en-us.item_fumo_reimu_tooltip: A plush shrine maiden in red and white, wearing a round-faced, thoughtful expression.
en-us.item_fumo_marisa_tooltip: A plush magician in a big pointed hat, its brim tipped to one side.
en-us.item_fumo_cirno_tooltip: A plush ice fairy with crystal wings. It looks like the strongest.
en-us.item_fumo_sakuya_tooltip: A plush maid with a perfectly neat headdress.
en-us.item_fumo_remilia_tooltip: A small plush vampire with a pair of bat wings stitched on the back.
en-us.item_fumo_flandre_tooltip: A plush vampire whose wings are hung with colorful crystals. Hug it gently.
en-us.item_fumo_patchouli_tooltip: A plush magician in pajama-like robes, looking like it has not quite woken up.
en-us.item_fumo_youmu_tooltip: A plush gardener with two little wooden swords and a half-phantom floating beside it.
en-us.item_fumo_yuyuko_tooltip: A plush ghost princess in a triangular headpiece, extra soft to the touch.
en-us.item_fumo_chen_tooltip: A plush two-tailed nekomata whose ears droop a little depending on how it sits.
en-us.item_fumo_sanae_tooltip: A plush shrine maiden in blue and white, with snake and frog hair ornaments.
en-us.item_fumo_satori_tooltip: A plush with a third eye on its chest. Being looked at by it feels like having your mind read.
en-us.item_fumo_koishi_tooltip: A plush in a wide black hat. It never moves, yet people keep forgetting it is there.
en-us.item_fumo_reisen_tooltip: A plush with tall rabbit ears and striking red eyes.
en-us.item_fumo_deka_reimu_tooltip: A Reimu plush the size of a body pillow. Getting it out of a crane machine is a small miracle.
en-us.item_fumo_deka_yukari_tooltip: A pillow-sized Yukari plush holding a tiny parasol, smiling as if it knows something.
